admission.justification: Borrowing the primary checkout interpreter can import the landed source instead of the candidate and misreport candidate tests or scripts as verified.

applicability: Commands a task runs on its own code candidate: tests, lint, type checks and agent scripts.
conditions: Build the environment at intake before the first candidate command, from that worktree's frozen lock with its source installed editable.
Repeat the documented build with explicit replacement after a sync changes the lock.
The shared interpreter, uv cache and rollback cache are disclosed shared effects; primary checkout and other worktrees are not written.
exclusions: Installed AR tools and memory-operation CLI, which operate the landed product.
Certification environments and the preserved Git-hook selection policy.
Automatic worktree-start setup before the ten-start measurement warrants it.

evidence: scripts/bootstrap-mcp-venv.sh --replace in leaf worktree, exit 0, 157-line log scratch l136-evidence/replace-run2.txt; freeze A3 journal 260928-MIK-L136-A3

statement: Every candidate command runs in an environment built in the task's own code worktree by the one documented command, at intake and after lock-changing syncs, with the candidate's source installed.
